verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks that a programmatic consumer can subscribe to. The adjacent features do not qualify: proxy streaming pushes real-time updates to SDKs, the tracking plugin sends events to Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager and Segment, and the REST API is pull-based. None of these are webhook subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
